# Polymux

> Polymux is a desktop AI workspace that brings chats, email, files, browser tabs, and a user's choice of AI models together in one place.

Polymux runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It lets a user ask one assistant to find and work with the right conversation, file, or browser page while keeping the workspace and model choice together. Browser-extension access is limited to tab metadata and the exact tab assigned to a task.

## Source and support

- [Source repository](https://github.com/CarlvinceTan/Polymux): Source code, issues, and release history.
- [Privacy contact](mailto:carlvince@polymux.com): Privacy questions.

## Product facts

- Product name: Polymux
- Category: Desktop AI workspace
- Platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux
- Current site release: 0.2.3
- Core surfaces: Chat, Hub, Drive, Browser
- Connected services include messaging, email, cloud drives, local files, hosted AI providers, and local models.
